label: Visual QA Matrix Organ
purpose: Generates comparable assets across presets, recipes, and render quality tiers so visual drift and over-expensive effects are inspectable before intake.
rules: Every matrix item must identify target, recipe, tier, and estimated cost.
PNG baking is optional; SVG generation remains dependency-free.
Generated files are hashed in the QA manifest.
A failed renderer may not invalidate the source SVG path.
